Mark / Aisha / Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the context — happy to help. I'm Rina, the AWS PDM on the ACE intake for this region. Quick responses:
- AWS doesn't mandate a single MOU template for co-sell; we typically align commercial terms via the marketplace listing and a mutual action plan. There are standard marketplace and co-sell paperwork templates we can share.
- For ACE readiness we usually collect: SOC 2 summary, dataflow diagram showing where customer data resides, and a short security questionnaire (I can send the template).
- Workshop timing: May 20 (14:00 ET) or May 21 (10:00 ET) both work for me; please confirm what works for Piedmont.

I'll attach the ACE enrollment checklist and the standard PDM onboarding doc to this thread. Jordan — if you can share the mutual action plan with owners, I'll add AWS milestones and a CO-SELL readiness flag.

Best,
Rina Patel
Partner Development Manager (AWS ACE)
